studies.name: Classic
studies.description: Closest to the original: forest green, round eyes, and a generous smile.
studies.brief: Keep the approved plain original almost exactly: flat deep forest green #23483b rounded square with soft corners radius about 18% body width, two round cream dot eyes spaced generously, bold curved cream smile (a simple clean arc). No bevel or internal gradient. Let precise original-like face proportions do the work. Only a tiny natural cast shadow behind the green body.
studies.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand edit. Reference image is the approved original BoxHaven happy-box design sheet. Produce ONE app icon artwork only, no sheet, no typography, no labels, no extra icons. Change only the treatment described below while preserving the core idea of a normal smiling box. Use a square canvas, transparent outside the white macOS-style rounded-square tile. Tile occupies about 86% of the canvas width with a subtle short drop shadow; inner smiling box occupies 70% of the white tile width, centered optically. Both normal square shapes, with inner body corners clearly tighter than tile corners. Straight uninterrupted top and side edges; symmetric body; nothing above the head. Two eyes and a simple happy smile are the only facial elements. No cabin, no ears, sprouts, limbs, second box, notches, folded corner, eyes on stalks, hats, terminal prompt, checkmark or unrelated additions. High quality restrained logo craftsmanship, warm forest/paper identity. Pixel-clean silhouette, high contrast. Transparent alpha outside the white tile. This is a review concept, not a production asset.

studies.name: Square & calm
studies.description: Tighter corners and upright eyes make the box feel a little more grown-up.
studies.brief: A flat forest-green normal square with tighter corner radius 10% body width. Two slightly vertical oval cream eyes, with generous spacing, a short shallow cream curved smile. Calm, friendly, confident expression. Face lies slightly below the vertical center of the body. No top seam, no texture, no bevel. Very restrained close shadow. Sharper body, quieter face than original.

studies.name: Wide smile
studies.description: A more expressive face with a wider smile and smaller eyes.
studies.brief: Flat forest-green normal rounded square radius 16% body width. Two smaller round cream eyes. A wider thin curved smile, about 34% body width, distinctly wider than the original, slight asymmetry in the mouth's curve for a natural cheerful expression but not tilted head. No cheeks, eyebrows or extra features. The face feels welcoming rather than babyish. No bevel or gradient.

studies.name: Printed shadow
studies.description: A crisp sage shadow adds depth without changing the silhouette.
studies.brief: Same normal flat forest-green rounded square and round cream eyes and smiling arc as the original. Behind the box add ONE crisp muted sage shadow, offset downward and right by only 5% of body width, like a simple two-color screen print. Shadow follows exactly the same rounded-square silhouette and never extends above or left of the foreground body. It is a thin shadow edge, NOT a separate box. No diagonal extrusion lines or notches. Keep face restrained and clean. No blur on this graphic shadow.

studies.name: Paper box
studies.description: An outlined box connects the mark to the light-paper interface.
studies.brief: A bold dark forest-green outline of a NORMAL rounded square, radius 14% body width, stroke about 5% body width. Interior warm white #f7f6f1, two solid forest-green circle eyes, one forest-green curved happy smile. No fill-colored slab, no roof or parcel flaps. Strong single-color graphic identity; stroke stays robust at small sizes. Tiny close cast shadow only behind body optional. Preserve original happy face in positive ink rather than white cutouts.

studies.name: Soft depth
studies.description: Subtle material shading for the Dock; a flat version would serve as the logo.
studies.brief: Normal rounded square forest-green happy box, round cream eyes and cream curved smile. Matte ceramic-like finish with VERY gentle diffuse upper-left illumination, slight dark lower-right edge entirely inside normal square silhouette. No shiny highlight band, no glossy plastic, no seams or bevel outlines. Front-facing normal square. Tiny ambient contact shadow gives depth. Understated tactile app-icon interpretation of original flat smiling box; face remains flat graphic.
